Thursday check-in gets your badge; Friday access is separate. messages.content: Raleigh finally sent the October outline: Oct 14-16, Tuesday evening staff demo, all-day Wednesday, Thursday morning coaching. Can you sort flights and hotels by practical fit, not just cheapest?

Yes. For flights, what time does the Tuesday demo start, and do we have a firm Thursday release time? Also, should I use the North Raleigh clinic address from their email for hotel and transport comparisons?
Use the North Raleigh address. I need to be there by 5 p.m. Tuesday. Thursday release isn't confirmed; assume late morning but flag anything that depends on it.

Flight patterns from TPA to RDU: practical lead is Tue 10:40 a.m.-12:25 p.m. nonstop, Thu 2:15-4:05 p.m. nonstop, about $326. It gives a grocery or hotel stop before the demo and a sane Tampa arrival. Cheapest is the same Tuesday outbound but a Thu 5:55 p.m. connection through Atlanta, home 10:35 p.m., about $238; price is nice but Friday looks rough. Maximum slack is Tue 8:05 a.m. via Charlotte with the same Thu 2:15 p.m. return, about $381.
That clean Thursday return is the one I’d want if the clinic can really wrap by 12:30. What did hotels look like?

Three reasonable ones. Clinic-adjacent Midtown Medical Hotel: 0.4 mile from the clinic, $169/night, Google 3.8 with recent comments on housekeeping and hallway noise; queen rooms listed, coffee maker listed, mini-fridge not confirmed, fitness room, seasonal outdoor pool, no hot tub. Crabtree Suites Raleigh: about 12-15 minutes by car, $184/night cancellable, Google 4.4; queen studio, coffee maker, mini-fridge confirmed, fitness room, indoor pool, no hot tub. Downtown hotel: nicer lobby, $205 plus parking, Google 4.2; more traffic and fridge by request.
I don't need a lobby. The adjacent one being below 4-ish and fuzzy on the fridge makes me nervous before an early Wednesday.

Then I would treat Crabtree Suites as the practical lead. The trade-off is the daily drive; the gain is a more reliable room setup and better recent reviews. Caveat is recovery: it has the indoor pool and fitness room but no hot tub. The adjacent hotel is only worth it if the clinic can store everything and you want to walk.
Check the transportation piece. I can manage a tote and braces, but I don't want to be stuck waiting on rideshares between suburban stops.

Rideshares are workable but not elegant: airport to Crabtree roughly $28-35, hotel to clinic $16-24 each way, plus Tuesday evening and any grocery stop. Total likely $120-160 with some commute-time surge risk. A compact rental is pricing around $46/day, about $145 all-in before fuel, and both nearby hotels show parking included. It also gives you a place for the tote while moving between clinic, hotel, and grocery.
Is RDU rental pickup a pain? I don't want to burn the whole Tuesday afternoon at a rental counter.

It is not terminal-walk simple, but it is manageable. RDU uses the rental car shuttle; budget about 20-25 minutes from curb to keys if the line is normal. With the noon-ish arrival, you should still have time to get the car, stop at the hotel, and reach the clinic before 5.
Okay, provisional rental. What do we need from the clinic before committing?

Main questions: exact Tuesday badge pickup time and entrance, whether you can drop the braces and handouts Tuesday night, whether they have a locked office through Thursday, loading and parking instructions for a compact rental, Wednesday room setup and AV, and whether Thursday coaching is truly finished by 12:30 so the 2:15 return is safe.
Add whether the storage is climate-controlled. Some of the sample materials shouldn't sit in a car if it's warm.

Good catch. I added climate-controlled storage and whether anything can stay in the training room overnight. For the hotel, Crabtree's queen studio has a confirmed mini-fridge, so the clinic question is mostly about daytime and overnight materials, not your room food storage.
Don't book yet. Save the clean flight and Crabtree as lead. Keep the late return only as a price fallback, not the recommendation.

Saved that way: clean Tuesday late-morning outbound plus Thursday 2:15 p.m. return as lead; late connecting return marked price fallback with a home-after-10:30 warning. Crabtree Suites is lead; Midtown Medical is secondary with review and fridge caveats. Compact rental is penciled in pending parking and storage answers.
Send the clinic questions and set a fare check. If the clean return jumps a lot, I want to know before I hear back from them.

Sent the clinic email. I set a 48-hour fare and room-rate check, plus an alert if the Thursday 2:15 p.m. return disappears or the cancellable queen studio at Crabtree Suites sells out. No bookings made.

Yes. Book flights first. Regular economy is fine. Queen room at Crabtree, and compact rental after that.
Starting with flights. The seat map shows windows available: outbound 12A is included, and return 15F is $18. Do you want me to take the paid return window or leave that seat for check-in?

Add the compact rental. I want enough time on Thursday for fuel and return without sprinting through security.

Thursday plan now leaves the clinic at 12:35, quick fuel stop if needed, rental return by about 1:10, security by 1:25 for the 2:15 flight. Tight only if coaching runs past 12:45.
